title: Prove the sharp joint dirty-word interval envelope (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp height-uniform interval envelope F(h)=floor(h^2/2)+h+2 for the unchanged #628 balanced word: every ordered pair of ideal-leaf cuts, both orientations and shared dirty scratch. The new upper proof matches #1374's credited lower family and closes #5872's gap. #1085's entry invariant and #1278's phase/squarefree results remain explicit premises.

Canonical base and source pin: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. Exact source-file hashes are in SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

```sh
python3 -B -W error -X dev research/chronological-dirty-intervals/verify.py
```

Expected: PASS_CHRONOLOGICAL_DIRTY_INTERVALS. Normal/optimized registered and read-only Git-free replays passed: 95,735 prefix boundaries, 89,528 intervals, 2,118 phase identities and 15 controls. A separately written compressed scalar engine checks attaining witnesses through h=32. Separate proof/code review found no unresolved gap under the imported premises.

## Limitations and next questions

No new κ. The bound is sharp across each height, not necessarily at every n; fixed-n sharpness remains open. Rounded callers, actual error support and the complete precision/physical invoice need separate integration. Five selected assumptions remain. Full-history validation was unavailable in the shallow checkout.

Full proof, predecessor credit and exact review hashes: [research package](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/02f7d03f0d09b1e05ae5c1f7433f07411db9102e/research/chronological-dirty-intervals). Original notices retained; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.
